name: Rivet
description: Rivet heads in rows, the domed ones proud of the plate and the countersunk ones flush.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; @size: @pick(44%, 62%); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); ${shadow} -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.35) { :after { -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 46%, #000 46%); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 46%, #000 46%); } } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
